card.name: Linking words before a verb phrase
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as who, and, whose, his or 't that sit right before an expected action verb, usually in general web prose about people's behavior.

modes.label: Relative word before a verb
modes.description: The word who or whose follows a group of people and leads into what they do.
modes.example: insurance-holders<< who>> cheat on their claims

modes.label: And joining two actions
modes.description: The word and links two clauses or verbs, with the next verb still to come.
modes.example: pick just one or two disciplines<< and>> dig into them

modes.label: Other words before an action
modes.description: A possessive, a noun or a contraction comes right before a verb or verb-like noun.
modes.example: if you don<<’t>> cook the food

card.writes: It favors Chinese tokens and suppresses common Chinese action verbs like do, take and hit, so it adds little clear output.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words right before the text says what people do.
